headings.usage: H1, H2, Hero sections, Recipe titles, and major calculator labels. Must use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Data, UI elements, paragraphs, timers, calculators, input labels.

typography.instructions: Import both fonts via Google Fonts in index.css. Use fluid scaling for headings (e.g., text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl for H1). Do not use generic fonts like Inter for headings to maintain the artisan feel.

colors.rules: Avoid pure black/white. Never use flat SaaS blue. The theme is 'Organic & Earthy' (Archetype 1) mimicking flour, baked crust, and olive oil. Ensure high contrast for text (APCA standard). Only use accent_cta for primary actions like 'Calcola' (Calculate), 'Salva' (Save).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces with 1px border-border (Muted Sand). No heavy neumorphism. Subtle ambient shadows (shadow-sm) for recipe cards, and shadow-lg on hover with -translate-y-1 for interactivity.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle grain/noise background image overlay on the main container with low opacity (mix-blend-multiply opacity-20) to kill digital flatness and simulate a physical, tactile flour-dusted workspace.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for thin, elegant, high-end iconography that matches the artisanal vibe.

grids_and_layouts.calculators: Mode B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with tight gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. Used for 'Calcolatore Impasto' (Dough Calculator), 'Forza Farina (W)' (W Blend Calculator), and 'Lievitazione' (Leavening Timers).
grids_and_layouts.recipe_library: Mode A: The Tetris Grid. Asymmetric grid for recipe browsing. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gap-8. Mix tall and wide image cards for visual tension.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have generous internal padding to avoid text collision.

components.strategy: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing/landing presentation. Use Shadcn UI strictly for functional logic (forms, inputs, tabs, sliders, dialogs) but heavily customize them by stripping the default 'Vercel' look to fit the warm artisan brand.
components.banned: Card-heavy UI for deep calculators (go flat/cardless instead). Transparent backgrounds on headers without backdrop-blur.
components.specific_usage: Use Tabs for switching Preferments (Biga, Poolish, Water Roux). Use Sliders for Hydration (Idratazione) %. Badges for flour W strength.

motion.interactions: Hover states must lighten/darken clearly (e.g., hover:bg-[#A6442E] hover:text-white). Micro-interactions on form inputs. Entrance animations for recipe lists using Framer Motion (staggered fade-up). Image hover triggers subtle scale (1.05).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure min 4.5:1 for body text. Interactive elements must have clear focus states (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C2533B] focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='calculate-dough-button', data-testid='login-google-button').

image_urls.description: Artisan sourdough bread on jute - perfect for 'Pane' category or the Main Hero background.
Neapolitan round pizza - perfect for 'Pizza Tonda' category card.
Person holding white ceramic bowl with focaccia bread - 'Focaccia' category.
Person holding/kneading dough - great for Dough Calculator background or empty states.

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. If placing text over images, use a max black overlay (e.g., bg-black/40) or gradient overlay to maintain text legibility.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this entire JSON carefully before writing code.
Execute commands to install required dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion sonner
Use Javascript (.js/.jsx), NOT Typescript, for all created components, as the current environment uses App.js.
Implement the 'Organic & Earthy' Archetype accurately using the provided color hex codes. Do NOT deviate to generic SaaS blues or teals.
The UI must be entirely in Italian (e.g., 'Calcola Impasto', 'Lievitazione', 'Aggiungi Ricetta', 'Biga', 'Poolish').
Implement the bento grids (Mode B for calculators, Mode A for recipe galleries).
Make sure forms and input layouts are left-aligned for data legibility.
Header must have a background (e.g., crystal glass backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) - do not leave it fully transparent over content.
For Shadcn UI components, use standard generic commands but implement them as .js.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js (or .jsx)
